description:
The Azure WebJob **DataProcessorJob** is configured to run in **Scheduled** mode. Its first execution is slated to begin at **2026-07-01T02:00:00Z** and will conclude by **2026-07-01T04:00:00Z** on the same day.

During this window the job will repeat automatically, running **every 2 Hour(s)** as defined by the recurrence settings. This schedule ensures the data processing task is invoked twice within the two‑hour period.
